meta.summary: AI spend policy for a 101-500 person software company scaling AI usage, with envelopes set at 2.0x sector median and normal approval controls.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if a company-contracted equivalent exists or if the spend exceeds $25 per month without prior Engineering lead approval.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 85% consumed within the calendar month
Team envelope exceeds variance band or company envelope reaches 90% consumed
Company envelope fully consumed before month end or unapproved agent spend detected

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $5,000 monthly Support envelope and is correctly tagged to a customer-facing-inference project, classifying as COGS under the production environment rule.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38 falls well within the $8,000 Data envelope; the job carries a valid project tag and no approval is required at this spend level.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight, breaching the 35% variance band on the Engineering envelope; the most likely cause is an unoptimized prompt or model version change introduced in the deploy, requiring Engineering lead review.
rationales.e4: Marketing has now submitted three ChatGPT Team subscriptions this quarter, meeting the team_subscription_threshold of 2 duplicate subscriptions, triggering automatic reroute to the company OpenAI contract.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 fine_tune_over_usd approval threshold; the request is routed to Engineering lead for approval before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 25 max_retries_per_task limit, and its $47/hr burn rate exceeded the $40/hr kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled spend.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is within the 72-hour window and the cost delta is within the $250 max_delta_usd cap; Engineering lead approval is required before routing is changed.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key spiked to 22x baseline with no project tag, triggering ladder step 2 throttle under the Engineering lead; the experimentation carve-out is preserved pending tag attribution within 12 hours.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent purchased a $499 dataset license, which is within the $500 single_txn_ceiling_usd and falls under the data-licensing merchant scope on the agent card; the transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video tool at $89/month overlaps with the Sales team contract at $1,400/year running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggered the new_provider_rule; the charge is held pending Engineering lead approval and completion of the provider security questionnaire.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling was submitted as COGS; the internal-tooling project_tag rule overrides the production environment default and reclassifies the spend as OpEx.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date AI spend at 87% of the $40,000 company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 85% burn_alert_pct threshold; the alert is active and team leads are notified to pace remaining spend.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, classification rules, and agent guardrails are within policy parameters for the period.
